errors.text_span: wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen in 1%-Intervallen angegeben sind
errors.evidence: The y-axis tick labels are presented in 2-percentage-point intervals (-1, 1, 3, 5, etc.), not 1% intervals.
The value for the blue solid line in 2024 is approximately 3.5%, not 6.4%.

errors.text_span: mit einem Tiefpunkt von etwa 2,7% im Jahr 2014
errors.evidence: The value for the blue line in 2014 is approximately 5.3%. The actual low point for this line is in 2013 at approximately 2.8%.
The value for the purple line in 2024 is negative, approximately -0.5%, not 2.2%.

errors.text_span: mit einem Tiefpunkt von etwa -0,8% im Jahr 2009
errors.evidence: The value for the purple line in 2009 is positive, at approximately 2.5%. The lowest value in the historical data is in 2014 (just above 0%), and the projected absolute low is in 2024 (approx. -0.5%). The stated value and year are both incorrect.

errors.text_span: einem Höhepunkt von etwa 6,1% im Jahr 2020
errors.evidence: The peak for the purple line in 2020 is visibly above the blue dashed line (which is at 6.3%), placing it at approximately 6.8%. The reported value of 6.1% is incorrect.
